Our Philosophy

Music is a language
everyone can speak

At Rheym, we believe that musical ability isn't a gift reserved for the few — it's a skill that can be cultivated with the right guidance, environment, and passion.

Our faculty brings decades of performance and pedagogical experience across classical, jazz, pop, and contemporary genres. We tailor every lesson to your unique learning style and musical aspirations.

What We Offer

Our Programs

🥁

Drums / Percussion

Learn rhythm, coordination, and groove from the ground up. From basic beats to advanced fills — we develop solid technique and a strong musical foundation for all ages.

All Ages · All Levels
🎹

Piano

From your very first notes to advanced repertoire — classical, pop, or contemporary. We build technique, expression, and a lifelong love of keys.

All Ages · All Levels
🎸

Guitar

Acoustic or electric, beginner or seasoned player. Learn chords, scales, strumming, fingerpicking, and your favourite songs.

Beginner → Advanced
🎤

Singing

Develop your voice, range, and confidence. Covering pop, classical, musical theatre, and more — for all ages and vocal types.

All Ages · All Styles
🪗

Ukulele

Fun, approachable, and deeply musical. Perfect for beginners and a joy for experienced players exploring new sounds.

Great for Beginners
🎻

Violin

Build posture, bow technique, and tone from the ground up. We guide students through classical and contemporary violin with care.

Ages 5+ · All Levels
🎻

Cello

Rich, expressive, and deeply rewarding. Our cello lessons develop strong fundamentals and beautiful tone at every stage.

All Ages · All Levels
🎵

Music Theory

Harmony, rhythm, ear training, notation, and composition — theory that makes you a better musician on any instrument.

Online & In-Person

Our Story

The History of Rheym Music School

1994

Musical Journey Begins

Mr. Raymond Geocada became the organist and choir head at the Blessed Arnold Janssen Chapel in Cainta — a role he dedicated himself to for 13 years.

1999

Academic Achievement

Completed studies in Mechanical Technology at Don Bosco Technical College in Mandaluyong City — showcasing commitment to both music, academics, and technology.

2007 – 2021

St. Arnold Janssen Shrine Parish

Transitioned to serve as organist at the St. Arnold Janssen Shrine Parish, continuing his musical contributions for over a decade.

2016

Rheym Music School Founded

Living in Janssenville, Cainta, Rizal, Mr. Geocada combined his love for music and teaching by establishing Rheym Music School — offering personalized home service music lessons to the local community.

2018 – Present

Full-Time Music Teacher

As the owner and full-time music teacher, Mr. Geocada continues to inspire and nurture a new generation of musicians across Cainta, Rizal and nearby communities.

🎹
Mr. Raymond Geocada
Founder & Music Teacher

Despite not having formal music education, Mr. Geocada's talent and dedication as an organist grew tremendously over the years. He honed his skills through practical experience, continuously improving his craft across piano, guitar, and voice.

His extensive experience combined with his passion for sharing knowledge makes Rheym Music School an ideal place for students to learn and develop their musical abilities — all in the comfort of their own homes.

"Music is for everyone."

Since its inception, Rheym Music School has provided personalized and convenient music education to students across Cainta, Rizal and beyond — fostering a love for music and helping students reach their full potential.
